name: Foldline pleated shell
description: A collarless cropped shell concept with an offset curved zip and cocoon sleeves. Overlapping charcoal panels conceal cobalt accordion pleats at the sides. The idea is a quiet silhouette that reveals color as it opens and moves.

name: Spiral wrap lounge set
description: A cropped wrap hoodie and petal-panel shorts concept. Spiraling seams, an asymmetric hem and tonal binding create the contrast through patternmaking, with no slogan or emblem. A softer, more sculptural take on a coordinated lounge set.

name: Contour drape set
description: An offset-neckline top with a draped side extension and a long wrap skirt. Two sweeping black-bound curves trace the ivory panels; a small oval side clasp anchors the silhouette. A study in structure and fluidity.

name: Afterimage draped jersey
description: An asymmetric draped jersey concept with an exposed shoulder, scarf-like neckline extension and flared cuffs. An abstract orbital halftone print dissolves into scattered dots, suggesting presence that fades rather than spelling out a mood.

name: Crescent barrel denim
description: Sculpted barrel jeans built around crescent-shaped inset panels and articulated curved seams. An offset waistband and two small red bar tacks provide detail. A pattern-cutting concept with volume through the leg.

name: Origami halter set
description: A folded-panel halter and fluid wide-leg trousers with an overlapping hip wrap. Angular folds meet soft movement, with a restrained oval connector at the neckline. An evening set shaped by contrast in construction.

name: Camera Shy flash tee
description: For the person who loves the night but ducks the photo. A washed-black oversized tee concept with a censored flash graphic on the back, CAMERA SHY lettering and a discreet oval mark on the front.

name: Selectively Social wrap set

name: Do Not Perceive cap
description: Low profile. Loud boundary. A washed-charcoal cap concept with DO NOT PERCEIVE embroidery and a flash of red beneath the brim. A playful extension of the Camera Shy story.

name: Seen / Unseen convertible bag
